readings.title: The Completion of the Work
readings.subtitle: Mosheh Inspects the Furnishings
readings.text: [Exodus 39:32] And all the work of the Dwelling Place of the Tent of Appointment was completed. And the children of Yisra’ěl did according to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh, so they did. [33] And they brought <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place to Mosheh, <dn>את</dn> the tent and <dn>את</dn> all its furnishings, its hooks, its boards, its bars, and its columns, and its sockets, [34] and <dn>את</dn> the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and <dn>את</dn> the covering of fine leather, and <dn>את</dn> the veil of the covering, [35] <dn>את</dn> the ark of the Witness with its poles, and <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement, [36] <dn>את</dn> the table, and <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the showbread, [37] <dn>את</dn> the clean lampstand with its lamps, the lamps to be put in order, and <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and <dn>את</dn> the oil for light, [38] and <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of gold, and <dn>את</dn> the anointing oil, and <dn>את</dn> the sweet incense, and <dn>את</dn> the covering for the Tent door, [39] <dn>את</dn> the bronze slaughter-place and <dn>את</dn> its bronze grating, <dn>את</dn> its poles, and <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, <dn>את</dn> the basin with its stand, [40] <dn>את</dn> the screens of the courtyard, <dn>את</dn> its columns and <dn>את</dn> its sockets, <dn>את</dn> the covering for the courtyard gate, <dn>את</dn> its cords, and <dn>את</dn> its pegs, and <dn>את</dn> all the utensils for the service of the Dwelling Place, for the Tent of Appointment, [41] <dn>את</dn> the woven garments, to do service in the set-apart place: <dn>את</dn> the set-apart garments for Aharon the priest, and <dn>את</dn> his sons’ garments, to serve as priests. [42] According to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ěl did <dn>את</dn> all the work. [43] And Mosheh looked over <dn>את</dn> all the work and saw they did it as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded, so they had done. And Mosheh blessed <dn>את</dn> them.

readings.title: Raising the Tent of Appointment
readings.subtitle: The Command to Assemble
readings.text: [Exodus 40:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“On the first day of the first new moon, you are to raise up <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [3] <dq>and shall put in it <dn>את</dn> the ark of the Witness, and screen the ark with <dn>את</dn> the veil.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall bring in <dn>את</dn> the table and arrange <dn>את</dn> what belongs on it, and bring in <dn>את</dn> the lampstand and light <dn>את</dn> its lamps.</dq> [5] <dq>“And you shall set <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of gold for the incense before the ark of the Witness, and put up <dn>את</dn> the covering of the door to the Dwelling Place.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall set <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of the ascending offering before the door of the Dwelling Place of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [7] <dq>and shall set <dn>את</dn> the basin between the Tent of Appointment and the slaughter-place, and shall put water therein.</dq> [8] <dq>“And you shall set up <dn>את</dn> the courtyard all around, and shall place <dn>את</dn> the covering of the courtyard gate,</dq> [9] <dq>and shall take <dn>את</dn> the anointing oil, and anoint <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place and <dn>את</dn> all that is in it, and shall set it and <dn>את</dn> all its utensils apart, and it shall be set-apart.</dq> [10] <dq>“And you shall anoint <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of the ascending offering and <dn>את</dn> all its utensils, and set <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place apart, and the slaughter-place shall be most set-apart.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall anoint <dn>את</dn> the basin and <dn>את</dn> its stand, and set it apart.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall bring <dn>את</dn> Aharon and <dn>את</dn> his sons to the door of the Tent of Appointment and wash <dn>את</dn> them with water.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the set-apart garments on <dn>את</dn> Aharon, and anoint <dn>את</dn> him and set <dn>את</dn> him apart to serve as priest to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [14] <dq>“And you shall bring <dn>את</dn> his sons and put long shirts on them,</dq> [15] <dq>and shall anoint <dn>את</dn> them, as you anointed <dn>את</dn> their father, and they shall serve as priests to <dn>Me</dn>. And their anointing shall be for them an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”</dq> [16] And Mosheh did according to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> him, so he did.

readings.title: The Assembly of the Tabernacle
readings.subtitle: Mosheh Completes the Work
readings.text: [Exodus 40:17] And it came to be in the first new moon of the second year, on the first day of the new moon, that the Dwelling Place was raised up. [18] And Mosheh raised up <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place and placed <dn>את</dn> its sockets, and set up <dn>את</dn> its boards, and put in <dn>את</dn> its bars, and raised up <dn>את</dn> its columns, [19] and spread <dn>את</dn> the tent over the Dwelling Place and put <dn>את</dn> the covering of the tent on top of it, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [20] And he took <dn>את</dn> the Witness and put it into the ark, and he put <dn>את</dn> the poles through the rings of the ark, and put <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement on top of the ark, [21] and brought <dn>את</dn> the ark into the Dwelling Place, and placed <dn>את</dn> the veil of the covering to screen off the ark of the Witness, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [22] And he put <dn>את</dn> the table in the Tent of Appointment, on the north side of the Dwelling Place, outside the veil, [23] and set <dn>את</dn> the bread in order upon it before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [24] And he put <dn>את</dn> the lampstand in the Tent of Appointment, opposite the table, on the south side of the Dwelling Place, [25] and lit the lamps before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [26] And he put <dn>את</dn> the gold slaughter-place in the Tent of Appointment in front of the veil, [27] and burned sweet incense on it, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [28] And he set up <dn>את</dn> the covering to the door of the Dwelling Place. [29] And he put <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of ascending offering before the door of the Dwelling Place of the Tent of Appointment, and offered upon it <dn>את</dn> the ascending offering and <dn>את</dn> the grain offering, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [30] And he put <dn>את</dn> the basin between the Tent of Appointment and the slaughter-place, and put water therein for washing. [31] And Mosheh, and Aharon, and his sons washed <dn>את</dn> their hands and <dn>את</dn> their feet with water from it, [32] as they went into the Tent of Appointment, and as they came near the slaughter-place. They would wash, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [33] And he raised up <dn>את</dn> the courtyard all around the Dwelling Place and the slaughter-place, and placed <dn>את</dn> the covering of the courtyard gate. And Mosheh completed <dn>את</dn> the work.

readings.title: The Esteem of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: The Cloud and the Fire
readings.text: [Exodus 40:34] And the cloud covered <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Appointment, and the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> filled <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place. [35] And Mosheh was not able to come into the Tent of Appointment, because the cloud dwelt on it, and the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> filled <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place. [36] And when the cloud was taken up from above the Dwelling Place, the children of Yisra’ěl went onward in all their journeys. [37] But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out till the day that it was taken up. [38] For the cloud of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was on the Dwelling Place by day, and fire was on it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Yisra’ěl, in all their journeys.

readings.title: The Cloud Over the Dwelling Place
readings.subtitle: Guarding the Charge of YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Numbers 9:15] And on the day that the Dwelling Place was raised up, the cloud covered <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place, the Tent of the Witness. From evening until morning it was above the Dwelling Place like the appearance of fire. [16] Thus it was continually: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night. [17] And whenever the cloud was taken up from above the Tent, after that the children of Yisra’ěl would depart. And in the place where the cloud dwelt, there the children of Yisra’ěl would camp. [18] At the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl departed, and at the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they camped. They remained camped as long as the cloud dwelt above the Dwelling Place. [19] Even when the cloud lingered many days above the Dwelling Place, the children of Yisra’ěl guarded <dn>את</dn> the Charge of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and did not depart. [20] And so it was, when the cloud was above the Dwelling Place a few days: according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they camped, and according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they would depart. [21] And so it was, when the cloud dwelt only from evening until morning: when the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they departed. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud was taken up, they departed. [22] Whether two days, or a new moon or a year that the cloud lingered above the Dwelling Place to dwell upon it, the children of Yisra’ěl camped, and did not depart. But when it was taken up, they departed. [23] At the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they camped, and at the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they departed. They guarded <dn>את</dn> the Charge of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, at the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh.
